items.title: The diagonal of the Picard functor of a flat proper family is a locally closed immersion
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes that the diagonal of the Picard functor associated with a flat proper finitely presented family with f_*O_X = O_S is a locally closed immersion, which is the representability step behind the Picard scheme. The proof must compare two rigidified line bundles on the product, pass to the locus where they agree after twisting, and then show that locus is locally closed by exhibiting it as the support of a suitable module, using that formation of the relevant direct image commutes with base change because the family is flat and proper. The non-routine part is the locally-closedness argument rather than the formal diagonal computation. Retained author proof at lines 9217-9304.
